yt_desc:
IGNOU OAMS assignment last date EXTENDED to 24 November 2026!

IGNOU Student Evaluation Division (F.No. IG/SED/2026/11243, dated 20 November 2026) has extended the last date for submission of assignments through OAMS (Online Assignment Management System) for the December 2026 Term-End Examination to 24 November 2026. The earlier last date was 20 November 2026.

How to submit: Login to the IGNOU Samarth portal (https://ignou.samarth.edu.in), go to OAMS, and upload your assignment as ONE PDF per course (maximum 20 MB). Handwritten answers scanned into a single PDF per course.

Do NOT re-upload if you have already submitted the hard copy at your study centre / regional centre, or if you have already passed the assignment. Email submissions are NOT accepted.

December 2026 TEE starts on 25 November 2026.

Official notice (PDF): https://www.ignou.ac.in/viewFile/SED/notification/OAMS_Notification.pdf
